name: PEDIFLOR KIDZ MELON FLAVOUR Tooth Paste 70gm
introduction:
Introduction About PEDIFLOR KIDZ MELON FLAVOUR TOOTH PASTE

Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste is a medicated toothpaste that protects the enamel and manage cavities. Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste contains Sodium Mon Fluorophosphate and Xylitol as active ingredients that ensures good oral health and hygiene by managing the onset of new cavities due to bacterial action and improving the structure of degraded enamel.

Sodium Mon fluorophosphate is an anti-caries agent. It manages the enamel, which is the topmost layer of tooth, to get demineralized (degraded) along with ensuring the remineralization (improvement in structure) of the previously degraded teeth. Xylitol is a natural sweetener that does not harm the teeth. Thus, together, these ingredients act to manage caries.

Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste is recommended to be used only according to the directions given by the dentist. It should not be used by children under the age of 6, without the dentist’s recommendation. For children above the age of 6, care should be taken to use a pea sized amount of Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste, under the supervision of adults. Brush twice daily with a soft bristle toothbrush. Do not swallow Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste.

name: Quadrajel Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About QUADRAJEL GEL

QUADRAJEL GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine, Metronidazole and Lignocaine which belong to the groups of medicines called Antiseptic Antibacterial agents, Nitroimidazoles and Local Anesthetics, respectively. QUADRAJEL GEL is used to manage halitosis, gingivitis, oral stomatitis, pain due to mouth ulcers and food burns. It is also used to manage plaque growth on the teeth.

Halitosis is a condition that occurs due to trapped bacteria on the uneven microscopic surface of the tongue that produces odours, contributing to bad breath in an individual. Gingivitis is a form of gum disease that occurs due to poor hygiene and is generally characterised by symptoms such as swollen and receding gums.

Oral stomatitis is a condition characterised by painful swelling and sores inside the mouth that occur due to an infection, an allergic reaction or irritating foods. Mouth ulcers are small lesions that develop in your mouth or at the base of your gums, which make eating and drinking uncomfortable.

QUADRAJEL GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorhexidine or metronidazole. lignocaine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydroxybenzoate or para-aminobenzoic acid. Before applying QUADRAJEL GEL, inform your doctor if you have traumatised (injured) mucosa, sepsis (a life-threatening infection) in the application site, poor general health, severe liver disease and renal dysfunction and/or a partial or complete heart block.

QUADRAJEL GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy and only if necessary, in breastfeeding women. QUADRAJEL GEL is not recommended for use by children (below 12 years of age). The most common symptoms of applying QUADRAJEL GEL are dry mouth, altered taste sensations (such as metallic taste), discoloured or coated tongue, nausea, vomiting and abdominal discomfort. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply QUADRAJEL GEL to your face beyond 5 days. Avoid applying QUADRAJEL GEL around your eyes, including your eyelids.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before applying  QUADRAJEL GEL, inform your doctor, if you are applying  any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to manage blood clots) such as coumarin derivatives (Ex. warfarin)
Anti-arrhythmic drugs (used to manage a heart rhythm that's too fast or irregular) Ex. amiodarone
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Beta-blockers (used to manage high blood pressure)
General anesthesia (used to induce unconsciousness during surgery) Ex. propofol, ketamine
Benzodiazepine, barbiturate (used to manage anxiety and insomnia)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else applies too much of QUADRAJEL GEL or accidentally swallows it, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are circumoral paraesthesia (burning, prickling or itching sensation), numbness of the tongue, light-headedness, hyperacusis (unusual tolerance to ordinary environmental sounds), ringing in the ears, visual disturbance, muscular tremors, generalized & grand mal convulsions (seizures), unconsciousness, hypoxia (low oxygen level), hypercarbia (increased carbon-di-oxide in the blood), apnoea (serious sleep disorder), severe low blood pressure, slow heart rate, irregular heartbeat, arrhythmia and cardiovascular collapse.

METROHEX PLUS GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine and Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobial agents. It is used to manage skin inflammation caused due to skin infections, rosacea, minor burns and scalds, sunburn, scratches or abrasions. It can also be used to manage skin infections.

Apply a thin layer of METROHEX PLUS GEL on the affected areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. Before using METROHEX PLUS GEL inform your doctor if you have any blood problems or any upcoming surgery on your brain, spinal cord or ears. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

introduction:
Introduction About SHY NM FOAMING TOOTH PASTE

Shy NM Foaming toothpaste is a foaming non fluoridated toothpaste used in adults and younger individuals for managing sensitive teeth. In addition, it helps to manage gum infections. Shy NM toothpaste contains Calcium Sodium Phosphosilicate (CSPS) as active ingredient that blocks the open dentinal tubules and shields from external stimuli.

When Calcium Sodium Phosphosilicate (CSPS) meets saliva, sodium ions are released which raises the PH to an essential level required for the formation of Hydroxycarbonate apatite (found in tooth enamel). CSPS releases calcium and phosphate ions to form calcium phosphate layer which crystallises into HCA and closes the opened dentinal tubules. Thus, it provides long-lasting protection against wearing away, sensitivity, and pain.

Always use Shy NM Foaming Toothpaste as advised by your dentist. Apply this toothpaste onto a soft bristle toothbrush and brush your teeth thoroughly for at least 2 minutes, twice a day. Make sure that you brush all the sensitive areas. Use peanut size amount of paste for children below 6 years of age. It may give a slight warm feeling at the initial time of usage.

Introduction About THERMOKIND F SPEARMINT FLAVOUR GEL

Thermokind F Gel is a medicated gel which is used in the management of dental caries and reduce sensitivity towards hot and cold. It contains potassium nitrate, sodium monofluorophosphate and triclosan as active ingredients which makes the teeth stronger and reduces sensitivity.

faqs.answer: A: It is generally advisable not to wash your mouth immediately after using Betadine Gargle. Shy NM toothpaste contains Calcium Sodium Phosphosilicate (CSPS) as active ingredient that blocks the open dentinal tubules and shields from external stimuli.

When Calcium Sodium Phosphosilicate (CSPS) meets saliva, sodium ions are released which raises the PH to an essential level required for the formation of Hydroxycarbonate apatite (found in tooth enamel). CSPS releases calcium and phosphate ions to form calcium phosphate layer which crystallises into HCA and closes the opened dentinal tubules. Thus, it provides long-lasting protection against wearing away, sensitivity, and pain.

Always use Shy NM Foaming Toothpaste as advised by your dentist. Apply this toothpaste onto a soft bristle toothbrush and brush your teeth thoroughly for at least 2 minutes, twice a day. introduction:
Introduction About REXIDIN M FORTE GEL

REXIDIN M FORTE GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine, Metronidazole and Lignocaine which belong to the groups of medicines called Antiseptic Antibacterial agents, Nitroimidazoles and Local Anesthetics, respectively. REXIDIN M FORTE GEL is used to manage halitosis, gingivitis, oral stomatitis, pain due to mouth ulcers and food burns. It is also used to manage plaque growth on the teeth.

Halitosis is a condition that occurs due to trapped bacteria on the uneven microscopic surface of the tongue that produces odours, contributing to bad breath in an individual. Gingivitis is a form of gum disease that occurs due to poor hygiene and is generally characterised by symptoms such as swollen and receding gums.

Oral stomatitis is a condition characterised by painful swelling and sores inside the mouth that occur due to an infection, an allergic reaction or irritating foods. Mouth ulcers are small lesions that develop in your mouth or at the base of your gums, which make eating and drinking uncomfortable.

REXIDIN M FORTE GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorhexidine or metronidazole. lignocaine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydroxybenzoate or para-aminobenzoic acid. Before applying REXIDIN M FORTE GEL, inform your doctor if you have traumatised (injured) mucosa, sepsis (a life-threatening infection) in the application site, poor general health, severe liver disease and renal dysfunction and/or a partial or complete heart block.

REXIDIN M FORTE GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy and only if necessary, in breastfeeding women. REXIDIN M FORTE GEL is not recommended for use by children (below 12 years of age). The most common symptoms of applying REXIDIN M FORTE GEL are dry mouth, altered taste sensations (such as metallic taste), discoloured or coated tongue, nausea, vomiting and abdominal discomfort. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

CLOTRIN MOUTH PAINT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole. CLOTRIN MOUTH PAINT should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Senquel F Gel is a medicated gel which is used in the management of dental caries and reduce sensitivity towards hot and cold. It contains potassium nitrate, sodium monofluorophosphate and triclosan as active ingredients which makes the teeth stronger and reduces sensitivity.

Potassium nitrate is an anti-sensitivity agent which acts on the dentinal tubules and calms the nerves leading to reduced sensitivity to hot and cold. Sodium monofluorophosphate is an anticaries agent which manages decay and makes the teeth stronger. Triclosan is an antibacterial agent which kills the bacteria and helps against infections.

Always use Senquel F Gel as advised by your dentist. It is for dental use only. Do not swallow or exceed the daily recommended dosage. Take advised amount of this gel on your toothbrush and brush your teeth generously with it. Swish and spit it out. It should be used with caution in children to avoid swallowing of the gel.

Povinanz Gargle is an antiseptic and disinfectant agent that provides relief from sore throat and dry mouth. It also has an antiplaque activity that manages tartar buildup and keeps the gums healthy. It provides fresh breath, retains gloss, and is safe to use with dental fillings.

Povinanz Gargle contains Povidone Iodine Povidone-iodine as an active ingredient which possesses a broad-spectrum activity against a wide variety of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, fungi, protozoa, yeast, and even spores and viruses.

introduction:
Introduction About TOSTI GEL(ORAL)

TOSTI GEL(ORAL) contains triamcinolone acetonide, which belongs to a group of medicines called corticosteroids. It is used to manage and relieve itching and inflammatory conditions of corticosteroid-responsive skin diseases (dermatoses) such as seborrheic otitis externa (ear infection), dermatitis (skin inflammation) including allergic contact dermatitis (itchy skin rash due to allergies), winter dermatitis (a skin disease that occurs during winter), eczema (a dry, itchy, inflamed skin condition), psoriasis (a skin disorder with raised, rough, reddened areas covered with dry, fine silvery scales) and diaper rash, etc.

Before applying TOSTI GEL(ORAL) inform your doctor if you have Cushing’s syndrome (overproduction of corticosteroid hormones), hyperglycemia (elevated blood sugar levels), glucosuria (glucose in the urine) and increased pressure in the brain.

TOSTI GEL(ORAL) should be used during pregnancy only if necessary. TOSTI GEL(ORAL) should be used with caution by breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether it passes through breast milk. TOSTI GEL(ORAL) should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects get worse or persist.

OCTENOXA GARGLE can also be used to manage gingivitis (mild form of gum disease that causes irritation, redness and swelling of the part of your gum around the base of your teeth).

OCTENOXA GARGLE is not recommended for use in infants and children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice. It should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Introduction About KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT

KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of oral candidiasis or thrush. These infections are caused by yeast-like fungi called Candida. oral candidiasis or thrush is a fungal infection which is caused by the accumulation of the fungus in the mouth region affecting the mouth, tongue and regions around it.

KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole. KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women and children above three years of age. Consult your doctor before applying it.

Before taking KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT inform your doctor if you’re under any medications. The common side effects of KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT are abnormal liver functioning, nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, itching and abnormal taste. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT Works

KANSEL MP MOUTH PAINT works by managing the fungus' growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in the breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in the membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and the management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About SENSODENT KF FOAMING DENTAL GEL

Sensodent KF Dental Gel is a medicated oral gel which is used in the management of Dentinal Hypersensitivity (DH). It contains potassium nitrate and sodium monofluorophosphate as key ingredients which provides strength to the teeth.

Sodium Monofluorophosphate is an anticaries agent, that reduces the demineralisation of enamel and protects the teeth from cavities. Potassium nitrate is a desensitising agent which blocks the exposed dentinal tubules (tooth structure which is present next to the enamel layer) which are responsible for causing painful sensitivity. It builds protection against sensitivity of teeth to stimuli such as heat, cold, acids, and sweets.

Always use Sensodent KF Dental Gel as advised by your physician/dentist. It is for dental use only. Take required quantity (approximately 2.5cm) of the paste in a soft bristle toothbrush and brush thoroughly twice a day. Do not swallow the toothpaste. Make sure that you brush the sensitive areas for long time. Consult your dentist if the problem persists of if you are using it for more than four weeks.

It contains chlorhexidine gluconate and hyaluronic acid as active ingredients that help optimize oral hygiene.

Povinanz Gargle is an antiseptic and disinfectant agent used for infected and inflammatory conditions of the mouth and pharynx caused by bacterial or monilial infections such as tonsilitis, pharyngitis, stomatitis, traumatic ulcers and during dental surgery. It contains povidone iodine as an active ingredient to decrease the risk of infection of the mouth by killing the micro-organisms.

Always use Povinanz Gargle as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only and shake well before use. Anabel Liquid Gel is a combination medicines used to manage mouth ulcers. It contains Benzalkonium Chloride, Choline Salicylate, Lignocaine Hydrochloride as active ingredients that helps to reduces the pain, swelling, redness, and burning sensation of the ulcers.

Choline Salicylate works by blocking the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) which cause pain, redness and swelling. Lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that works by blocking pain signals from the nerves to the brain which decreases the pain sensation. Benzalkonium Chloride is an antiseptic and disinfectant that reduces risk of infection.

Use Anabel Liquid Gel as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Do not swallow Anabel Liquid Gel. It is used for managing pain and inflammation (redness, swelling and a feeling of heat) in the throat or mouth like mouth ulcers, sore throat, tongue or gums, discomfort associated with dentures and pain after dental surgery.

Before using BENZIN GARGLE inform your doctor if you have a history of asthma. BENZIN GARGLE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Rinse the medicine around your mouth or use it as a gargle, for 20 to 30 seconds then spit it out. Do not swallow it. If you get it in your eyes accidentally, wash them immediately with cold water. Introduction About PEDIFLOR KIDZ BUBBLE GUM TOOTH PASTE

Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste Bubblegum Flavour is a medicated toothpaste that is used in children to protects the enamel and manage cavities. It contains Sodium Monofluorophosphate and Xylitol as active ingredients that ensures good oral health and hygiene.

Sodium Monofluorophosphate is an anti-caries agent. It manages the enamel (the topmost layer of tooth) from getting demineralized (degraded) along with ensuring the remineralization (improvement in structure) of the previously degraded teeth. Xylitol is a natural sweetener that does not harm the teeth. Thus, together, these ingredients act to manage caries.

Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste Bubblegum Flavour is recommended to be used only according to the directions given by the dentist. It should not be used by children under the age of 6, without the dentist’s recommendation.

For children above the age of 6, care should be taken to use a pea sized amount of Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste Bubblegum Flavour, under the supervision of adults. Brush twice a day with a soft bristle toothbrush. Do not swallow Pediflor Kidz Toothpaste Bubblegum Flavour.

Always use Betakind Mint Flavour Gargle as advised by your physician. It is for oral use only. Gargle or rinse with up to 10 ml of Betakind Mint Flavour Gargle for up to 30 seconds without swallowing. Repeat at least 2-4 hours for as long as required.

introduction:
Introduction About PINKGUMS GEL

PINKGUMS GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine, Metronidazole and Lignocaine which belong to the groups of medicines called Antiseptic Antibacterial agents, Nitroimidazoles and Local Anesthetics, respectively. PINKGUMS GEL is used to manage halitosis, gingivitis, oral stomatitis, pain due to mouth ulcers and food burns. It is also used to manage plaque growth on the teeth.

Halitosis is a condition that occurs due to trapped bacteria on the uneven microscopic surface of the tongue that produces odours, contributing to bad breath in an individual. Gingivitis is a form of gum disease that occurs due to poor hygiene and is generally characterised by symptoms such as swollen and receding gums.

Oral stomatitis is a condition characterised by painful swelling and sores inside the mouth that occur due to an infection, an allergic reaction or irritating foods. Mouth ulcers are small lesions that develop in your mouth or at the base of your gums, which make eating and drinking uncomfortable.

PINKGUMS GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorhexidine or metronidazole. lignocaine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydroxybenzoate or para-aminobenzoic acid. Before applying PINKGUMS GEL, inform your doctor if you have traumatised (injured) mucosa, sepsis (a life-threatening infection) in the application site, poor general health, severe liver disease and renal dysfunction and/or a partial or complete heart block.

PINKGUMS GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy and only if necessary, in breastfeeding women. PINKGUMS GEL is not recommended for use by children (below 12 years of age). The most common symptoms of applying PINKGUMS GEL are dry mouth, altered taste sensations (such as metallic taste), discoloured or coated tongue, nausea, vomiting and abdominal discomfort. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About LOREX ML MOUTH GEL

LOREX ML MOUTH GEL is used to manage halitosis, gingivitis, oral stomatitis, pain due to mouth ulcers, and food burns. It is also used to manage plaque growth on the teeth. LOREX GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine, Metronidazole, and Lignocaine, which belong to the groups of medicines called Antiseptics, Nitroimidazoles, and Local Anaesthetics, respectively.

It works by healing ulcers by decreasing the number of bacteria in the mouth, leading to decreased swelling and redness of the gums; it also kills bacteria or other microorganisms by damaging their DNA; and it also provides relief from painful mouth sores by forming a protective coating over the sores and blocking their pain signals.

Always apply LOREX ML MOUTH GEL as directed by your physician. It is for oral use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer with a clean finger or cotton swab 2-3 times a day. Do not rinse the mouth or eat anything for 30 minutes.

LOREX ML MOUTH GEL is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorhexidine or metronidazole. lignocaine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydroxybenzoate, or para-aminobenzoic acid.

Before applying LOREX ML MOUTH GEL, inform your doctor if you have traumatized (injured) mucosa, sepsis (a life-threatening infection) in the application site, poor general health, severe liver disease and renal dysfunction, and/or a partial or complete heart block.

LOREX ML MOUTH GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy and only if necessary in breastfeeding women. LOREX ML MOUTH GEL is not recommended for use by children (below 12 years of age).

The most common symptoms of applying LOREX ML MOUTH GEL are dry mouth, altered taste sensations (such as metallic taste), a discoloured or coated tongue, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal discomfort. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
